Name: Strathwood Whidbey Cast-Aluminum Round Dining Table
Materials: Aluminum
Round 4-person dining table with 2-inch umbrella hole in the center Made of durable yet lightweight, rust-resistant cast aluminum Elegant multi-step hand finish and scrolling lattice motif design on top Some assembly required; coordinates with Whidbey collection (sold separately) Measures 48 inches in diameter by 28 inches high Rust Free Cast Aluminum Frame Elegant Multi-Step Hand Finish Sturdy Construction
